newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on strong yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on strong yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Thursday, as the yen's sharp rise against the dollar fuelled long-liquidiation by private investors, traders said.
Rubber prices ranged from 0.5 yen to 2.3 yen per kg lower.
Benchmark October was closed 1.5 yen lower at 142.2 yen.

The market extended early losses as the yen climbed further against the dollar. "The yen's sharp rise took many market participants by surprise. Market direction hinges on the currency market," one analyst at a commodity broker said.
